clarityArrangement.priorities: Regular branch geometry, shortest direct exterior departures, distinct connections and generous local clearance. Crossing counts remain reported; they do not override these requirements.

finePass.coordinatePolicy: Round node and bend coordinates to whole graph units. P1 alone retains a derived Y coordinate so its centre lies exactly on the inner ellipse; X is integral.

reviewedRoutes.M5|U4: Restore the exterior ellipse lane above P4 after manual dragging.
reviewedRoutes.M8|L1: Leave M8 horizontally and enter the flat top of L1 beside the acquisition line.
reviewedRoutes.L1|F1A: Enter the bottom centre of F1A with a clear final vertical approach.
reviewedRoutes.F1B|F1C: Enter the right centre of F1C with room for the arrowhead.
reviewedRoutes.C8|C9: The manually positioned nodes now allow a straight connection.
reviewedRoutes.Q15|C7: Pass above Q4 and below the C chain without touching either.
reviewedRoutes.W1|W6: Clear the right side of E6 after moving the W chain.
reviewedRoutes.U17|C8: Clear V3 and E6 and use a separate right-hand arrival at C8.

upperRightArrangement.priorities: Keep the approved western geometry and exterior routes exact. Arrange coherent branches and feedback loops, keep target ports distinct, and report crossing tradeoffs rather than using crossing counts alone.

reviewedRoutes.P4|K1: Leave P4 to the right before turning down, keeping the vertical acquisition corridor clear.
reviewedRoutes.I1|I3: Arrive level on the right side, clear of the rounded corner.
reviewedRoutes.K10|K13: Soften the diagonal into a safe top entry.
reviewedRoutes.I7|T14: Approach the right side separately from the K7 top entry.
reviewedRoutes.K6|K9: Keep the manual outer route and finish at the top centre, separated from both outgoing branches.

easternArrangement.tradeoffs: The K6 exterior approach, I1–R1 bridge and U22 return are longer. K6 crosses two connections rather than one; I1–R1 crosses the main spine once. The R branch interiors and T branch interiors remain uncrossed.

communityArrangement.tradeoffs: Q24–Q29 and Q30–P5 are longer to keep the F4 loop together at the outer left and separate the political branch from the other P5 arrivals. The existing Q15–C7 crossing with E1–E2 remains; P5 and all its other branches are reserved for a later pass.

redevelopmentArrangement.tradeoffs: The U6-U13 connection is longer and crosses P5-E6, X3-P5 and P5-W1. This replaces eight crossings spread across the former redevelopment returns and V chain. Both C8 returns are uncrossed, including their shared junction; P5, V1-V4 and all completed regions remain fixed.

p5Arrangement.tradeoffs: E1-E2 is longer, following the lower-left perimeter to replace five central crossings with two at the unchanged Q15/Q16 returns to P2. It removes the old E1 junction recrossing; the three P5/W/E6/X branches are direct and no longer cross one another. Their three crossings of the fixed U6-U13 connection remain. P5, all Q geometry, all U geometry and all W/T positions remain exact.

manualFinePass.scope: Round node positions and existing bends; level the reviewed near-horizontal rows. No bend insertion/deletion, rerouting, horizontal repositioning beyond rounding, or composition changes.
